ns2:course.label: Genomic Analysis of Insects
ns2:course.description: Comprehensive and integrated presentation of insect genomic analysis from the molecular level to that of the population; concepts are applied to certain aspects of insect population regulation. Offered in alternate years. Prerequisite: IB 204 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: IB 204 or consent of instructor.
